## Grok support
Use Grok for conversations and code review, including Grok Build through ACP.
## Project and worktree settings
Choose local or remote repository sources, configure worktree folders and commands per project, and start a subthread from a conversation's context menu.
## Review workflow improvements
Manage local branches from the Review panel, see review actions and Auto Fix progress in the conversation, and apply selected fixes in the order shown. Ask an agent for help when worktree cleanup fails.

## Safer branch and worktree management
See branches, worktrees, and their matching pull requests together. Start work in a safe worktree from the current conversation, reuse an existing worktree for a subthread, and remove branches and worktrees with clearer safeguards.
## More useful review fixes
Choose how Auto Fix builds and tests after changes, rerun failed tests, and follow review progress in the conversation. Fixes check findings before acting and explain what they defer.
## Clearer conversations and test results
Keep the conversation at the latest response as cards finish laying out, open file links directly from the transcript, and see more useful details when tests fail.

## More control over review fixes
Choose whether Auto Fix builds and tests after a fix, and follow adversarial review progress in the conversation. Stop interrupts more of the work in progress. Fixes check review findings before acting and explain findings that are deferred.
## Clearer test runs
Filter test runs by status, see their elapsed time, and give agents more useful details when tests fail. The test queue releases checkout holds when a timed-out process has finished.
## Smoother review and conversation navigation
Pull request selection follows the current thread, and merge status and refresh controls are clearer. The conversation stays at the bottom as streamed content and cards finish laying out.
